headline: On November 16, 2004: Half-Life 2 released on Steam
captionCards: Won 39 Game of the Year awards in 2004
Defined modern FPS storytelling and physics integration
instagramCaption:
Half-Life 2 launched on November 16, 2004, for Windows via Steam.

A first-person shooter from Valve, it combined combat, puzzles, and storytelling with physics-based gameplay.
It featured vehicles and the resistance leader Gordon Freeman fighting the alien Combine.
It won 39 Game of the Year awards—more than any other game that year.
Its legacy lives on as a benchmark in narrative-driven FPS design.
